about: Public keys of the agents that commit to this repository. Every commit is signed with one of these keys and names the session recorded here (Dinis, 19 November 2026).

keys.label: cells@AgentiCCells.dinis (held by cells.b@, Claude Code session on Dinis's second account)
keys.role: Runs the AgentiCCells site factory (AgentiCCells/AgentiCCells__Site__Factory). A session key: it ends with its session.
keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 18 November 2026 with sgit pki keygen; public bundle from sgit pki export. Only the public half is here; the other half stays in the session.
keys.authorised: Dinis, 2026-11-18 ~22:48 UTC: "when we onboard a new session here, that session should create the public key and overwrite the public key... we can only have one official that I need to authorize every time we do the shift. So now this becomes the official one."

ssh_signing.note: This agent signs its git commits with the bundle.sign key (ECDSA P-256, sha256:26870890ec91ec9d) as an SSH signature (namespace git). build/check-signatures.mjs derives the OpenSSH form from bundle.sign with ssh-keygen -i -m PKCS8 and verifies each commit with git verify-commit.
